functions.name: create_device_status
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_device_status()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin

    insert into public.device_status (
        device_id,
        status,
        last_seen_at
    )
    values (
        new.id,
        'offline',
        null
    );

    return new;

end;
$function$
